patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with a dark, semi-transparent overlay provides a strong visual anchor while ensuring text readability.
Elegant, slightly condensed serif typeface (Arizona Flare) is used for prominent headings, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and subheadings.
A muted, natural color palette featuring soft greens, beiges, and a deep teal/grey for accents and overlays, creating a calming and sophisticated feel.

The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content. The top navigation bar transforms into a sticky header upon scroll, shifting its layout and gaining a solid background.
Distinct content sections are visually separated by alternating soft, muted background colors (light beige and light sage green), providing clear segmentation without harsh transitions.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where the background image moves at a slower rate than the overlaid text and call-to-action, creating a sense of depth. The primary navigation elements transition into a sticky header after the user scrolls past the initial hero, adjusting their position and gaining a solid background for improved visibility against varying content.

Full-bleed hero images are used with a dark, semi-transparent color overlay to ensure high contrast and readability for white text placed over the image. Content sections are visually delineated by alternating background colors, using soft, muted tones to maintain a cohesive and gentle aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for primary section titles, with a clean sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) is consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and product cards, creating a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy density, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating an open and uncrowded layout.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an elegant, slightly condensed serif typeface for headings, paired with a calming, muted natural color palette, creates a sophisticated yet approachable brand identity. The subtle hero parallax adds a premium touch without being distracting.
